name: Splat Rasterization via Raycasting
aliases: EWA Splat Rasterization via Ray-Plane Intersection
definition: A rasterization technique for splats on GPUs optimized for triangles, using point primitives as screen-space squares and casting a ray for each fragment to test inclusion in the splat.
summary: Splat Rasterization via Raycasting accurately projects 3D splats by casting rays per fragment to test inclusion in quadric surfaces, avoiding the underestimation artifacts of previous approximations.
